newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African tourism board set for major restructure.
newsitem.headline: S.African tourism board set for major restructure.

text.p: South Africa tourism parastatal, Satour, will undergo a major restructure to transform it into a body which can lead the industry to becoming a major foreign exchange earner, a government minister said.

Environmental Affairs and Tourism Minister Pallo Jordan said on Tuesday that Satour, the government's vehicle to market South Africa abroad, would have a new board in place by March/April 1997 to lead this process.

"Once in place, the new Tourism Board will be tasked with the swift restructuring of Satour so as to transform it into an organisation with which all South Africans would want to associate," Jordan said in a statement.
Jordan said although crime had impacted negatively on South Africa's image abroad, tourism was continuing to grow.
He said the ministry was engaged in talks with regional ministries to examine the possibilities of marketing the southern African region as a tourist destination.
